content: Is menge Kevuwazan ni Isacar
Si Isacar, ne zuen anak din he heepat he menge maama: si Tola, si Pua, si Jashub, wey si Shimron.

Ne is menge anak ni Tola, ne iyan si Uzi, Refaya, Jeriel, Jamai, Ibsam, wey si Shemuel. Heini sikandan ne iyan menge pengulu te menge pemilya zan. Ne hein iyan hadì si David, ne is kezakel te menge maama he ebpuun te menge kevuwazan ni Tola he memahagtì he menge sundaru ne 22,600.
Is anak ni Uzi he maama, ne iyan si Izrahia. Si Izrahia wey kes heepat he menge anak din, ne iyan si Micael, Obadias, Joel, wey si Ishia ne menge pengulu te menge pemilya zan.
Mezakel is menge esawa zan wey menge anak dan, umbe sumalà te listahan te menge kevuwazan dan ne zuen kandan 36,000 he menge maama he andam he ebpenilbi pinaaǥi te kegkesundaru.
Is kezakel te menge maama he ebpuun te kevuwazan ni Isacar he memahagtì he menge sundaru, ne 87,000 sumalà is diyà te listahan te menge kevuwazan dan.
Is menge Kevuwazan ni Benjamin
Si Benjamin, ne zuen anak din he tetelu he menge maama: si Bela, si Beker, wey si Jediel.

Si Bela, ne zuen anak din he lelima he menge maama: si Ezbon, si Uzi, si Uziel, si Jerimot, wey si Iri. Menge pengulu heini sikandan te menge pemilya zan. Ne is kezakel te memahagtì he menge sundaru zan, 22,034, sumalà is diyà te listahan te menge kevuwazan dan.
Is menge anak ni Beker ne si Zemira, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremot, Abia, Anatot, wey si Alemet. Iyan heini sikandan menge anak ni Beker.
Ne is kezakel te memahagtì he menge sundaru zan, 20,200. Heini sikandan wey is menge pengulu te menge pemilya zan ne nelista ziyà te listahan te kevuwazan dan.
Is anak ni Jediel ne si Bilhan. Ne is menge anak ni Bilhan, ne iyan si Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Kenaana, Zetan, Tarshish, wey si Ahishahar.
Heini sikandan ne menge pengulu te menge pemilya zan. Ne 17,200 is memahagtì kandan he andam he ebpesundaru.
Is menge anak ni Ir ne iyan si Shupim wey si Hupim, ne is anak ni Aher ne iyan si Hushim.
Is menge Kevuwazan ni Naftali
Is menge anak ni Naftali he menge maama, ne iyan si Jaziel, Guni, Jezer, wey si Shilem. Menge kevuwazan sikandan ni Bilha is iney ni Naftali.
Is menge Kevuwazan ni Manase
Duen dezuwa he anak ni Manase ziyà te esawa zin he Aramihanen, he si Asriel wey si Makir. Si Makir ne amey ni Gilead
ne si Makir nen-ahà te ibpeesawa ki Hupim wey ki Shupim. Duen etevey ni Makir he egngezanan ki Maaca. Is sevaha pa he anak ni Makir iyan si Zelofehad he pudu vahi is menge anak din.
Duen daan anak ni Makir he menge maama ziyà te ki Maaca he egngezanan ki Peresh wey ki Sheresh. Is menge anak ni Peresh he menge maama iyan ensi Ulam wey Rakem.
Is anak ni Ulam he maama iyan si Bedan. Iyan heini sikandan menge kevuwazan ni Gilead he anak ni Makir, he apù ni Manase.
Is etevey ni Gilead he si Hamoleket duen menge anak din he menge maama he iyan si Ishhod, Abiezer, wey si Mala.
Ne is menge anak ni Shemida he menge maama ne si Ahian, Shekem, Likhi wey si Aniam.
Is menge Kevuwazan ni Efraim
Iyan heini menge kevuwazan ni Efraim: si Shutela, Bered, Tahat, Eleada,
Zabad, wey si Shutela. Is menge anak ni Efraim he si Ezer wey si Elead, midhimetayan sikandan te menge meǥinged diyà te Gat, su ebpenakew zan te menge uyaǥen.
Neuǥet is kedlalew ni Efraim te kemetayen dan, ne midhendiyà is menge kezuzumahi zin su edlenganen dan sikandin.
Ne liwas dutun, mid-uvayan ni Efraim is esawa zin ne mibmeǥingey ne mid-anak te maama. Ne migngezanan ni Efraim haazà is batà te Beria, tenged te utew mesakit he neulaula zutun te kandan he pemilya.
Duen anak ni Efraim he vahi he si Sheera. Heini sikandin ne iyan midtukud te mevavà wey metikang he lugar te Bet Horon wey te Uzen Sheera.
Duen pa menge kevuwazan ni Efraim he si Reshef, Tela, Tahan,
Ladan, Amihud, Elishama,
Nun, wey si Josue.

Is menge tanà he nekuwa wey ed-ubpaan te menge kevuwazan ni Efraim, ne iyan is Betel wey is nekeliǥuy kayi he menge lugar, is Naaran he zapit te edsilaan wey is Gezer he zapit te edsenlepan wey is menge lugar he nekeliǥuy kayi, is Sekem wey menge lugar he nekelingut kayi pehendiyà te Aya wey te menge sakup kayi he lugar.

Is menge kevuwazan ni Manase iyan nekeǥaked te menge lugar te Bet Shan, Taanac, Megido, wey Dor, wey apil is menge lugar he nekelingut kayi. Iyan haazà menge inged he mid-ubpaan te menge kevuwazan ni Jose he anak ni Israel.
Is menge Kevuwazan ni Asher
Is menge anak ni Asher he menge maama, ne iyan si Imnah, Ishva, Ishvi, wey si Beria. Is etevey zan ne si Sera.
Is menge anak ni Beria he menge maama ne si Heber wey si Malkiel. Si Malkiel ne amey ni Birzait.
Si Heber amey ni Jaflet, Shomer, wey ni Hotam. Is etevey zan ne iyan si Shua.
Is menge anak ni Jaflet he menge maama, ne iyan si Pasac, Bimhal, wey si Ashvat.
Is menge anak ni Shomer he menge maama ne si Ahi, Roga, Huba, wey si Aram.
Is menge maama he anak te suled ni Shomer he si Helem ne iyan si Zofa, Imnah, Shelesh, wey si Amal.
Is menge anak ni Zofa he menge maama, ne iyan si Sua, Harnefer, Shual, Beri, Imra,
Bezer, Hod, Shama, Shilsha, Itran, wey si Beera.
Is menge anak ni Jeter he menge maama, ne iyan si Jefune, Pispa, wey si Ara.
Is menge anak ni Ula he menge maama, ne iyan si Ara, Haniel, wey si Rizia.

Sikandan is langun menge kevuwazan ni Asher he menge pengulu te menge pemilya zan. Memetau sikandan he menge sundaru wey nevantug he menge pengulu. Ne is kezakel zan te menge maama he kevuwazan ni Asher he andam he ebpesundaru 26,000 sumalà is diyà te listahan te menge kevuwazan dan.
